title: LugiaSMP Modpack
description: Modpack used in a private Cobblemon Minecraft server.
body: Modpack used in the LugiaSMP, a private server for me and my friends. Main mod is Cobblemon. This modpack also adds mods for optimization, like ImmediatelyFast. More additions include more armors, furniture, blocks, structures, backpacks, and a minimap. Quality of life features like Sodium, JEI, Jade, FallingTree, Effortless Structure, and Elytra Slot are also added.
